title: After decades out of mind, 'French Woodstock' resurfaces thanks to newfound footage
subhead: Fifty years after the Riviera 76 festival held its first and only edition in southern France, with a lineup that notably included Joe Cocker, Betty Davis and Magma, the National Audiovisual Institute has brought it back to life. A new televised documentary features restored footage from reels found in a cellar.

title: What young Israelis say about their country, its army, wars, politics and religion
subhead: War has become a constant backdrop to the lives of Israelis aged 15 to 30 and, for many, the price they must pay to be safe. Le Monde spoke with young people torn between the certainty that they are in the right place and wanderlust.
